ideas.text: insertion sort for 32 2 1 in ascending order
outer loop starts at index 1 and goes to last index inclusive
pick current element as key at each outer loop iteration
inner loop walks left from key position comparing elements
shift element right if it is greater than key
inner loop stops when element is not greater than key or left boundary is reached
insert key at the position where inner loop stopped
repeat outer loop for all remaining positions until array end
iteration 1: key=2, compare with 32, shift 32 right, insert 2 at index 0, array becomes [2, 32, 1]
iteration 2: key=1, compare with 32, shift 32 right, compare with 2, shift 2 right, insert 1 at index 0, array becomes [1, 2, 32]
